name: National B License
description: Fundamentals of vehicle dynamics: longitudinal braking threshold, out-in-out trajectory, weight transfer, and low-power roadster handling.

tests.title: 200m Acceleration & Braking (Short Threshold)
tests.description: Launch cleanly with minimal front wheelspin and execute threshold braking into the stop box.
tests.lesson_objective: Straight-line threshold braking without locking wheels or overshooting.

tests.title: 500m Acceleration & High-Speed Stop
tests.description: High-speed braking from 170+ km/h managing curb weight into the marked stop box.
tests.lesson_objective: Managing heavier curb weight braking without triggering front wheel lockup.

tests.title: Out-In-Out Hairpin Trajectory
tests.description: Brake in a straight line, clip the rumble strip late, and open the wheel on exit.
tests.lesson_objective: Late apex out-in-out line to preserve rolling momentum in a lightweight roadster.

tests.title: Front-Wheel Drive Understeer Management
tests.description: Modulate throttle mid-corner until front tires regain grip, then squeeze full throttle on exit.
tests.lesson_objective: Managing FWD power understeer through Curva del Muro.

tests.title: Low-Speed Weight Transfer & Transition
tests.description: Trail-brake into Brooklands and smoothly transfer lateral load into the looping Luffield radius.
tests.lesson_objective: Managing classic live-axle rear-wheel drive chassis dynamics.

tests.title: Threshold Braking from 190 km/h into Chicane
tests.description: Heavy straight-line braking at the 150m board down to 60 km/h and hopping the curb cleanly.
tests.lesson_objective: High-speed threshold braking and curb hopping through Prima Variante.

tests.title: Slalom Rhythm & Transient Agility
tests.description: Steering cadence and throttle feathering in 2nd gear through staggered cones without sliding.
tests.lesson_objective: Weight transfer control in a mid-engine roadster.

tests.title: Blind Compression Corner Entry
tests.description: Downhill compression turn-in over a blind crest and soaking vertical compression at the bottom.
tests.lesson_objective: Committing to blind crest turn-in and elevation drop at Paddock Hill Bend.

tests.title: All-Wheel Drive Launch & Traction Cornering
tests.description: Aggressive AWD launch, braking uphill deep into Turn 1, and leveraging quattro pull on exit.
tests.lesson_objective: Quattro all-wheel drive traction on uphill corner exit without understeer.

tests.title: High-Speed Carousel Feathering
tests.description: Balancing the car on the edge of adhesion through a long tightening carousel turn.
tests.lesson_objective: Throttle modulation through the Mercedes Arena carousel.

tests.title: S-Bend Line Straightening
tests.description: Sacrificing entry speed in Turn 2 to straighten the line and maximize exit speed up Hugenholtz.
tests.lesson_objective: Line straightening across linked corners in a classic rear-wheel drive coupe.

tests.title: Graduation: Vallelunga Club Full Lap
tests.description: Comprehensive graduation trial connecting all corners cleanly with zero track limit violations.
tests.lesson_objective: Synthesizing all National B fundamentals across a complete 1,746m lap.

name: National A License
description: Intermediate sports car dynamics: high-speed chicanes, blind off-camber drops, mid-engine balance, and turbo torque delivery.

tests.title: 1000m Maximum Acceleration & High-Speed Stop
tests.description: High-velocity braking from 225+ km/h managing inertia into the designated stop box.
tests.lesson_objective: Threshold braking from maximum speed in a powerful V8 sports coupe.

tests.title: Practical Cornering: Laguna Seca Hairpin (GT3 A-2)
tests.description: Downhill approach into the tight Andretti Hairpin. Manage trail braking and engage early 2nd-gear exit drive in the iconic AWD Godzilla.
tests.lesson_objective: Mastering trail-braking and AWD traction through a low-speed hairpin.

tests.title: Approaching a Low-Visibility Corner: Paddock Hill (GT6 A-2)
tests.description: High-speed blind plunge down Paddock Hill Bend. Keep the lightweight chassis balanced without upsetting the rear over the compression.
tests.lesson_objective: Carrying speed through a blind downhill compression corner.

tests.title: Racing Line & Heavy Braking: Variante del Rettifilo (GT7 A-3)
tests.description: Approach the first chicane at maximum velocity. Execute threshold braking in a hot hatchback, hop the kerbs cleanly, and accelerate out.
tests.lesson_objective: Front-wheel drive chicane braking and curb hopping.

tests.title: The Corkscrew: Severe Elevation Drop
tests.description: Braking uphill into a blind crest, dropping 5 stories through Turns 8 and 8A.
tests.lesson_objective: Navigating blind downhill elevation drops and bottom compression.

tests.title: Turbo Torque Modulation on Corner Exit
tests.description: Managing twin-turbo boost onset progressively out of Magione hairpins.
tests.lesson_objective: Preventing sudden boost spikes from breaking rear traction.

tests.title: Consecutive Corners: Variante della Roggia (GT7 A-6)
tests.description: Negotiate Curva Grande and brake into the tight left-right chicane of Variante della Roggia, balancing mid-engine agility.
tests.lesson_objective: Mid-engine direction changes through high-speed chicane transitions.

tests.title: Mid-Engine Snap Oversteer Control
tests.description: Avoiding abrupt throttle lift through off-camber Graham Hill Bend.
tests.lesson_objective: Controlling mid-engine lift-off snap oversteer in a carbon-tub sports car.

tests.title: High-Speed Curb Bouncing Chicane
tests.description: Attacking Variante Alta kerbs with straight steering before impact to avoid rear kicks.
tests.lesson_objective: Chicane curb jumping without unsettling suspension equilibrium.

tests.title: Downhill Hairpin Trail-Braking
tests.description: Steep uphill braking followed by a sharp downhill drop into Remus Hairpin.
tests.lesson_objective: Trailing brake pressure past turn-in to keep load on front tires.

tests.title: High-Speed Blind Crest Commitment
tests.description: Carrying 160+ km/h through the downhill Scheivlak crest without backing off.
tests.lesson_objective: Trusting aerodynamic and mechanical grip on blind corner exit.

tests.title: High-Speed Esses Precision
tests.description: Precision rhythm: lift for Maggotts, dab brakes into Becketts, wide exit into Chapel.
tests.lesson_objective: Linking high-speed S-curves at 180+ km/h.

tests.title: Rotary Engine High-RPM Throttle Feathering
tests.description: Maintaining the twin-rotary in its peak powerband while feathering throttle through Campagnano.
tests.lesson_objective: High-RPM power delivery control in a lightweight sports car.

tests.title: Green Hell Sector Trial: Hohe Acht to Brünnchen (GT4 A-16)
tests.description: Tackle the technical mid-section of the Nürburgring Nordschleife in the twin-turbo RX-7 Spirit R, mastering Wippermann, Eschbach, and Brünnchen.
tests.lesson_objective: Consecutive blind corner links and elevation management on the Nordschleife.

tests.title: Graduation: Brands Hatch Indy Full Lap
tests.description: Synthesizes blind drops, hairpin patience, and exit momentum across a complete sub-minute lap.
tests.lesson_objective: Mastering the undulating Brands Hatch Indy layout in a mid-engine coupe.

name: International B License
description: High performance & downforce commitment: modern supercars, slipstream overtaking, low-grip control, and high-speed chicanes.

tests.title: High-Speed Braking & Chicane: Variante del Rettifilo (GT7 Master IB-1)
tests.description: Braking from 270+ km/h in the legendary 288 GTO homologation special into Monza's tight first chicane.
tests.lesson_objective: Managing classic turbo supercar high-speed deceleration without ABS.

tests.title: High-Speed Heavy Braking into Tamburello
tests.description: Hard initial brake hit from 250 km/h, bleed off pressure, and flick left-right across high curbs.
tests.lesson_objective: High-speed deceleration and curb compliance in a mid-engine supercar.

tests.title: Rear-Engine Pendulum Dynamics & Traction
tests.description: Trail-braking to pin front tires into Cimini 1 and utilizing rear traction out of Cimini 2.
tests.lesson_objective: Mastering 911 rear-engine weight distribution and exit drive.

tests.title: Downforce Commitment: Pouhon Double-Apex
tests.description: Tap brake lightly, tuck into the first apex at 170 km/h, float mid-track, and pull tight for apex 2.
tests.lesson_objective: High-speed aero downforce commitment through Spa's downhill double-left.

tests.title: Big Displacement V8 Torque Modulation
tests.description: Steep uphill braking into Turn 1, rolling through Turn 2 Andretti Hairpin without spinning rears.
tests.lesson_objective: Managing instantaneous naturally aspirated V8 torque off-idle.

tests.title: Active Aerodynamics at 230 km/h
tests.description: Fast Turn 3 long right sweeper: trust ALA downforce, stabilize lateral load, carry immense speed.
tests.lesson_objective: Trusting active aerodynamic balance through long sustained lateral corners.

tests.title: Cornering from High Speed: Red Bull Ring Turn 1 (GT7 IB-6)
tests.description: High-velocity uphill braking into Niki Lauda Kurve. Clip the sausage kerb flat and exploit classic DTM balance onto the long straight.
tests.lesson_objective: Uphill deceleration and curb riding in an iconic homologation sports saloon.

tests.title: High-Speed Chicane Precision: Ascari
tests.description: Braking from 230 km/h into Variante Ascari, clipping left, right, and exit curbs in one fluid arc.
tests.lesson_objective: Precision high-speed direction changes across kerb complexes.

tests.title: Heavyweight Digital AWD Traction
tests.description: Managing 1,720 kg curb weight through the tight Schumacher-S and Kumho chicane complexes.
tests.lesson_objective: Harnessing ATTESA E-TS all-wheel drive vectoring on chicane direction changes.

tests.title: The Carousel at the Nürburgring (GT5 IB-8)
tests.description: Drop into the banked concrete Karussell bowl in the raw twin-turbo F40, holding the inner slab before powering out onto the crest.
tests.lesson_objective: Banked cornering and turbo boost throttle control without driver aids.

tests.title: Blind Crest Downhill Esses: Casanova-Savelli
tests.description: Right-hand crest into plunging left off-camber descent at Mugello: settle chassis before load shift.
tests.lesson_objective: Managing high-speed lateral load shifts with simultaneous elevation drops.

tests.title: High-Speed Parabolica Exit Momentum
tests.description: Brake progressively into Curva Alboreto (Parabolica), hug early apex, let car drift to exit curb.
tests.lesson_objective: Maximizing corner exit speed onto a 1-kilometer main straightaway.

tests.title: Historic High-Speed Drifting: Stowe & Club
tests.description: Bias-ply tires and big-block 7.0L V8: use throttle steer through Stowe and Club corners.
tests.lesson_objective: Managing high slip angles and mechanical chassis balance on historic layouts.

tests.title: Graduation: Red Bull Ring GP Full Lap
tests.description: Full flying lap around Spielberg combining elevation braking, fast sweepers, and curb discipline.
tests.lesson_objective: Putting all high-performance vehicle dynamics lessons together in a GT3 RS.

name: International A License
description: Professional motorsport racecraft: GT3, GT4, and DTM race machinery. Full slick tires, racing ABS/TC, high-downforce, and curb discipline.

tests.title: The Benchmark: Eau Rouge & Raidillon Flat-Out
tests.description: Downhill compression, blind left-right flick, and cresting exit over Raidillon at 240+ km/h.
tests.lesson_objective: Committing to maximum downforce without lifting through elevation compression.

tests.title: GT4 Trail-Braking & Weight Conservation
tests.description: Trailing brake deep into Westfield and Sheene Curve, managing natural understeer.
tests.lesson_objective: Conservation of momentum in a customer racing GT4 car without aero downforce.

tests.title: Extreme Downforce Cornering: Arrabbiata 1 & 2
tests.description: Flat-out right kink into Arrabbiata 1, dab brakes uphill, hook Arrabbiata 2 on the throttle.
tests.lesson_objective: Harnessing 800+ kg of GT3 aerodynamic downforce at 200+ km/h sustained.

tests.title: Spa-Francorchamps Sector 1 Trial: La Source to Kemmel (GT6 IA-4)
tests.description: Execute precision hairpin exit out of La Source, accelerate downhill into Eau Rouge, and blast onto Kemmel Straight in the GT-R.
tests.lesson_objective: Corner exit drive and high-speed compression commitment in an all-wheel drive flagship.

tests.title: Classic DTM Aggressive Curb Hopping
tests.description: High-revving 11,500 RPM V6: ride curbs through Acque Minerali compression and climb out.
tests.lesson_objective: Aggressive kerb usage and high-RPM naturally aspirated powerband management.

tests.title: Front-Mid GT3 Platform Stability
tests.description: High-speed sweeping Turn 9 (Campsa): brake in a straight line, turn in positively with aero grip.
tests.lesson_objective: Front-mid engine balance and trail-braking into medium-high speed entries.

tests.title: Bus Stop Chicane: Braking from 270 km/h
tests.description: Maximum braking threshold at 150m board: shift 6-to-1, curb hop right, flick left onto straight.
tests.lesson_objective: Extreme high-speed threshold deceleration and chicane direction transition.

tests.title: Rear-Engine GT3 Pivot & Curb Launch
tests.description: Braking deep into Ford Kurve: use rear weight bias to pivot car, open steering, power out.
tests.lesson_objective: Exploiting rear weight bias for corner rotation and traction drive in a GT3.

tests.title: GTE Aerodynamic Diffuser Suction
tests.description: High-downforce mid-engine 911 RSR through Copse Corner: 225 km/h apex, zero steering wiggle.
tests.lesson_objective: Maximum commitment to ground-effect diffuser suction at very high speed.

tests.title: Analog 1960s Prototype Mastery
tests.description: Historic Monza banking and pre-chicane flat-out sweepers: manual gearbox, bias-ply tires.
tests.lesson_objective: High-speed stability in an unfiltered 1960s endurance prototype.

tests.title: Group C High-Speed Commitment: Galgenkopf to Straight (GT7 Master IA-10)
tests.description: Carry enormous ground-effect speed through Galgenkopf onto the Döttinger Höhe straight in the Porsche 962C.
tests.lesson_objective: High-downforce ground-effect cornering and top-speed aerodynamic transition.

tests.title: Multi-Car GT3 Traffic Overtake
tests.description: Start P3 into Mercedes Arena, pass two AI competitors cleanly, and defend position through exit.
tests.lesson_objective: Wheel-to-wheel racecraft and overtaking under braking in GT3 machinery.

tests.title: Classic DTM Heel-and-Toe Dogfight
tests.description: Dogleg manual H-pattern gearbox: heel-and-toe downshifts under heavy braking into Tornantino.
tests.lesson_objective: Mastering manual heel-and-toe rev-matching under extreme deceleration.

tests.title: 1 Lap Guide Run: Nürburgring Nordschleife (GT4 IA-15)
tests.description: Full lap benchmark time attack around the Green Hell in the Mercedes-Benz 190E Evo II touring car.
tests.lesson_objective: Endurance pacing, rhythm, and track mastery across all 154 corners of the Nordschleife.

tests.title: Graduation: Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps Sector Trial
tests.description: Full middle sector trial (Les Combes through Stavelot): high speed, curb hopping, trail braking.
tests.lesson_objective: Flawless execution of high-downforce GT3 motorsport dynamics across a multi-kilometer sector.

name: Super License
description: The ultimate test of speed and discipline: full timed laps with zero room for error in Hypercars, Group C legends, LMP1, and Formula 1.

tests.title: Supercar Hot Lap: Laguna Seca
tests.description: Managing explosive hybrid torque out of Andretti Hairpin and the blind Corkscrew drop.
tests.lesson_objective: Full unassisted hot lap in a 963 bhp hybrid hypercar.

tests.title: British Heritage Time Attack: Brands Hatch GP
tests.description: Active aero and DRS deployment through narrow, barrier-lined woodland curves.
tests.lesson_objective: Full lap time attack in a 916 bhp hypercar around Brands Hatch GP.

tests.title: Applied Hot Lap: Nürburgring GP (GT5 S-3)
tests.description: Front-mid 6.2L AMG V8 naturally aspirated balance: thread the Mercedes Arena and high-speed chicane.
tests.lesson_objective: Precision high-speed throttle modulation in an iconic gullwing supercar.

tests.title: Lightweight Time Attack: Silverstone GP (GT6 S-3)
tests.description: Exploit pure mechanical downforce and lightweight 790 kg chassis through Maggotts-Becketts and Stowe.
tests.lesson_objective: Cornering commitment and high apex speeds in an ultra-lightweight track weapon.

tests.title: V12 AWD Supercar Lap: Brands Hatch GP (GT6 S-4)
tests.description: 740 bhp V12 naturally aspirated fury coupled with all-wheel drive stability on a historic natural amphitheater.
tests.lesson_objective: Managing high vehicle mass and extreme horsepower through narrow undulating bends.

tests.title: High-Downforce Aerodynamic Flow: Mugello
tests.description: Zero driving assists; connecting Casanova-Savelli and Arrabbiata 1 & 2 into one high-g rhythm.
tests.lesson_objective: Naturally aspirated V12 track special full circuit flow.

tests.title: High-Velocity Temple of Speed: Monza GP
tests.description: 370+ km/h down Monza straights; braking with high turbo boost and vintage ground effects.
tests.lesson_objective: Group C twin-turbo V8 top speed and minimal downforce braking.

tests.title: The 4-Rotor Symphony: Silverstone GP
tests.description: High-revving naturally aspirated R26B rotary engine screaming through Maggotts and Becketts.
tests.lesson_objective: High-RPM rotary powerband discipline and analog Group C precision.

tests.title: Undulating Perfection: Imola GP
tests.description: Porsche ground-effects prototype attacking Piratella, Acque Minerali, and Variante Alta curbs.
tests.lesson_objective: Group C ground effect venturi tunnel suction through undulations.

tests.title: Modern Hybrid Prototype Mastery: Spa-Francorchamps
tests.description: All-wheel drive hybrid electric boost out of Bus Stop and Eau Rouge; 1000 hp sustained.
tests.lesson_objective: LMP1-H energy recovery management, MGU-K all-wheel drive exit traction.

tests.title: 1,000 Horsepower Hybrid Attack: Red Bull Ring
tests.description: V8 hybrid acceleration out of Remus hairpin; maximum energy deployment through Turn 6 & 7.
tests.lesson_objective: Harvesting and deploying supercapacitor hybrid power across short sprint laps.

tests.title: Formula 1 V10 Apex Velocity: Barcelona GP
tests.description: 19,000 RPM 3.0L V10 F1 car: 4.5+ lateral g through Turn 3 and Campsa. Blistering reaction times.
tests.lesson_objective: Peak downforce commitment and sub-second decision making in a championship F1 car.

tests.title: Classic Le Mans Flat-12 Attack: Spa-Francorchamps (GT7 S-10)
tests.description: Wrestle 630 bhp in the iconic lightweight tube-frame flat-12 prototype through Eau Rouge, Blanchimont, and Pouhon.
tests.lesson_objective: Managing immense classic power with zero electronic assists around the longest high-speed circuit.

tests.title: Touring Car Dunes Hot Lap: Zandvoort
tests.description: Classic DTM touring car flying lap across the natural flowing sand dunes of Circuit Zandvoort.
tests.lesson_objective: High-RPM naturally aspirated momentum driving on a classic undulating European circuit.

tests.title: The Ultimate Trial: Nürburgring Nordschleife Silver Arrow (GT4 S-16)
tests.description: The definitive Gran Turismo final test: a full, unassisted flying lap of the Green Hell in the 720 bhp Sauber-Mercedes C9.
tests.lesson_objective: Flawless mastery of all 154 corners of the Nürburgring Nordschleife in a Group C Le Mans winner.
